title: SAXS Examinations of the Redox-Dependent Formation of a DNA-SOD1 Complex.
authors: Wang, Huiling; Wang, Mingfang; Nie, Zefeng; Qiu, Shuang; Huang, Xiaoping; Li, Xiang; Cui, Yanfang; Liu, Chunrong; Liu, Changlin
one_liner_zh: 该文通过SAXS研究SOD1蛋白与DNA复合物的氧化还原依赖性形成，属于广义蛋白-DNA互作，但非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验散射为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故评分为5。
abstract: Cu/Zn superoxide dismutase (SOD1) plays a key role in the maintenance of cellular reactive oxygen species (ROS) homeostasis as an antioxidant enzyme. We recently found that SOD1 is involved in the regulation of gene expression in response to changes in cellular ROS levels by binding to DNA-specific sequences. Moreover, the SOD1 binding to DNA was observed to be redox-dependent in solutions. Thus, we examined the redox-dependent DNA binding of SOD1 by multiple measurements, including small-angle X-ray scattering (SAXS), indicating the redox-dependent formation of a DNA-SOD1 complex in solutions. The redox-dependent formation of the DNA-SOD1 complex could underlie the SOD1 regulation of gene expression.
abstract_zh: Cu/Zn超氧化物歧化酶（SOD1）作为一种抗氧化酶，在维持细胞活性氧（ROS）稳态中发挥关键作用。我们近期发现，SOD1通过结合DNA特异性序列，参与响应细胞ROS水平变化的基因表达调控。此外，观察到SOD1与DNA的结合在溶液中具有氧化还原依赖性。因此，我们通过多种测量手段，包括小角X射线散射（SAXS），考察了SOD1的氧化还原依赖性DNA结合，结果表明溶液中DNA-SOD1复合物的形成具有氧化还原依赖性。DNA-SOD1复合物的氧化还原依赖性形成可能是SOD1调控基因表达的基础。
